anchor.quote: There was no single hide nor a yard of land, nor indeed one ox nor one cow nor one pig which was left out, and not put down in his record.
anchor.locator: Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, entry for 1085 (describing the survey)

body: The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle's description of the exhaustiveness of William I's 1086 survey — the most complete record of land, livestock, and obligation in any medieval European kingdom, and the fiscal backbone of Norman royal administration.
